statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: demos/cloudflare/src/pages/posts/[slug].astro, demos/playground/src/pages/posts/[slug].astro, demos/postgres/src/pages/posts/[slug].astro, demos/preview/src/pages/posts/[slug].astro, demos/simple/src/pages/posts/[slug].astro, templates/blog-cloudflare/src/pages/posts/[slug].astro, templates/blog/src/pages/posts/[slug].astro, packages/admin/src/components/ContentEditor.tsx, packages/admin/src/router.tsx, packages/admin/tests/**, .changeset/*.md.
